title: Credit Fundamentals
subtitle: Learn how credit works, protect yourself from scams, and take control of your financial future.
description: Free 8-module financial literacy course covering credit scores, credit reports, debt management, credit repair, personal loans, scam avoidance, and your legal rights. Self-paced, ~2 hours total.

modules.title: Understanding Your Credit Score
modules.description: What a credit score is, how it's calculated, FICO vs VantageScore, score ranges, and hard vs soft inquiries.

modules.title: How to Read Your Credit Report
modules.description: The 3 credit bureaus, reading each report section, spotting errors, disputing mistakes, and credit freeze vs lock.

modules.title: Building Credit from Scratch
modules.description: Starting with no credit, secured cards, credit builder loans, authorized user strategy, and a 6-month plan to 650+.

modules.title: Managing Debt Effectively
modules.description: Snowball vs avalanche, debt consolidation, dealing with collectors, medical debt, and managing debt on low income.

modules.title: Credit Repair — DIY vs Hiring Help
modules.description: What credit repair companies do, DIY process, goodwill letters, 609 disputes, spotting scams, and when to hire.

modules.title: Personal Loans & Borrowing Smart
modules.description: Secured vs unsecured loans, APR explained, comparing offers, bad credit options, and understanding loan terms.

modules.title: Avoiding Scams & Predatory Lending
modules.description: Red flags of predatory lenders, credit repair scams, BNPL traps, missed payment timelines, and verifying lenders.
modules.ctaText: Search verified lenders in your state

modules.title: Know Your Rights — State & Federal Protections
modules.description: FCRA, CROA, FDCPA protections, state lending laws, military protections, and where to file complaints.
modules.ctaText: Look up your state's lending laws
